_tuning_notes: Nile crocodile in swamps. Neutral on land, ambush predator in water: lunge_range is the scan radius in blocks, grab_ticks the drag duration (40 = 2s with two chews at half attack each). Not tamable, not breedable (no items set). Phase 3: diet.hunts doubles as cage-trap bait (item form of the prey). RARITY: tier 'uncommon' supplies the spawn weight; group_size and nearby_cap are pinned here (1-2, cap 4). nearby_cap denies natural spawns when that many of this animal are already within 64 blocks — the fix for persistent CREATURE mobs accumulating forever. ECOLOGY 0.4.2: Nile crocodiles are a river animal; the species was swamp-only and raw-id, so it saw no rivers and no Terralith biome at all. BABY SIZE 0.4.2: baby_scale moved 0.5 -> 1.0. The client already bakes the baby mesh through vanilla's BabyModelTransform (body halved, head full size) and vanilla age scaling halves the hitbox, so a 0.5 here was a SECOND shrink and calves rendered at a quarter of adult size. 1.0 = vanilla baby proportions. TERRALITH PASS: Terralith's ice_marsh joins #c:is_swamp; a Nile crocodile under ice is excluded for the same reason as frozen rivers.
guide_blurb: The river is its dinner table. Stay off the tablecloth.
